design_condition: Withdrawn from the surrounding streets and closely aligned with the larger neighboring school while respecting smaller buildings, the compact volume creates generous forecourts and a clear campus access axis.

positive.statement: The spacious forecourts and respectful distance from the small-format neighboring buildings create a convincing urban relationship.

position.rationale: Peripheral ground-level anchor approximates the forecourt relationship around the compact building.

positive.statement: The two entrances form a striking cross-street access axis to the campus.

position.rationale: Ground-level access-axis anchor is placed along the building’s southern approach.

positive.statement: The atrium and access cascade create generous lounge and learning areas while bringing daylight deep into the building.

position.rationale: Central void is clearly legible in the top view and remains vertically articulated in elevations.

positive.statement: The use ring is separated from the static measures so that the areas can be divided flexibly.

position.rationale: Perimeter ring is visible around the central atrium in plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The well-proportioned classrooms can easily be divided into group rooms.

position.rationale: A plausible upper-level perimeter location represents classrooms within the ring organization.

positive.statement: The compact building follows a strict, repetitive logic, so an economical solution can be assumed.

position.rationale: Compact repetitive massing is consistently visible across plan and all four elevations.

positive.statement: The project convincingly implements the demands for resource efficiency and low operating costs.

position.target: resource efficiency and low operating costs
position.rationale: This evaluates performance rather than a uniquely locatable architectural feature.

positive.statement: The use of daylight in all rooms is excellent.

position.rationale: Distributed upper and middle building anchor represents daylight access across the ring.

positive.statement: The open-space design impresses with surprising diversity and carefully interweaves with the architecture.

position.rationale: Peripheral ground-level anchor indicates open space interwoven around the building footprint.

negative.statement: The equipment rooms under the sloping skylight are structurally very complex.

position.target: equipment rooms under the sloping skylight
position.rationale: Upper central anchor follows the visible sloping roof profile above the atrium.

negative.statement: The dimensions and dominance of the bus shelter and double-decker bicycle parking are not yet completely convincing.

position.target: bus shelter and double-decker bicycle parking
position.rationale: Ground-level peripheral anchor approximates external campus equipment absent from the sampled cloud.

negative.statement: Delivery has only a waiting area, so material must be transported out of the weather, and there is no planning statement about disposal.

position.rationale: Peripheral ground-level anchor represents a plausible servicing area outside the building envelope.

negative.statement: Access to the roof area remains unclear despite the planned photovoltaic system.

position.rationale: Distinct upper roof profile and footprint are visible in plan and elevations.
